```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE)
invisible(Sys.setlocale("LC_CTYPE", "C.UTF-8"))  # keep non-ASCII symbols when built from a non-UTF-8 session
library(data.table)
asset <- 'docs/assets/isolaser_validation_all_autosomes'
x <- fread(file.path(asset,'calls.tsv.gz'), na.strings='NA')
for (col in c('panel_position','panel_ambiguous','inPanel','alleles_match'))
  set(x,j=col,value=tolower(as.character(x[[col]]))=='true')
x[, adjudicable := inPanel & !is.na(R2) & R2 >= .8]
hq <- x[adjudicable==TRUE]
confirmed <- hq$alleles_match & hq$g_nalt > 0
exact <- hq$alleles_match & hq$g_nalt == hq$i_nalt
p <- hq[alleles_match & g_nalt==1]
fmt <- function(n) format(n,big.mark=',',trim=TRUE,scientific=FALSE)
pct <- function(n,d) ifelse(d>0,sprintf('%.1f%%',100*n/d),'—')
manifest <- fread(file.path(asset,'run_manifest.tsv'))
stopifnot(nrow(manifest)==264L, uniqueN(manifest[,.(chr,tp,donor)])==264L,
          sum(manifest$calls)==nrow(x),!anyDuplicated(x[,.(chr,tp,donor,pos,ref,alt1)]))
```

We compared **all 22 autosomes, four donors and three timepoints (264 runs)**
against the donor genotype panel. Among `r fmt(nrow(hq))` adjudicable calls,
**`r pct(sum(confirmed),nrow(hq))` have a confirmed alternate allele** and
**`r pct(sum(exact),nrow(hq))` have an exactly matching genotype**.
The main discrepancy is a panel heterozygote called homozygous-alternate;
its frequency and the cost of increasing the depth cutoff are shown below.

# What was compared?

- **isoLASER:** completed default `--platform Nanopore` runs (`ont_roc`), for CD_21, CD_31, CD_36 and CD_48 at 0, 1 and 6 hours. These are the GM12878 ONT ROC model results, separate from the GTEx-model runs.
- **Reference:** the 100-line TOPMed-imputed genotype panel, using the corresponding four donor genotypes and GRCh38 coordinates.
- **Included calls:** PASS single-nucleotide variants with variant-site depth **DP ≥ 10**, one concrete alternate allele and a callable diploid genotype. The gVCF `<NON_REF>` placeholder is ignored.
- **Counting unit:** one donor × timepoint × variant. Repeated gene-level records for that call are collapsed by retaining the deepest record. Observations of the same variant in different donors or timepoints are counted separately.

The `r fmt(nrow(x))` calls represent `r fmt(uniqueN(x[,.(chr,pos,ref,alt1)]))`
distinct genomic variants. They are **variant calls, not splicing associations**.

Panel VCF: `/project/xinhe/lifan/neuron_stim/zicheng_100lines_all_snp_sorted.vcf.gz`.

**Matching:** panel records are located by chromosome and position, then matching
reference/alternate alleles are preferred. If there is no allele-matched record,
a unique panel record at that position can still document an allele discrepancy.
Conflicting panel records are marked ambiguous and excluded from adjudication;
they do not expand the number of calls. This affects `r fmt(sum(x$panel_ambiguous))` calls.

# How much does the panel confirm?

An **adjudicable** call has an unambiguous, callable donor panel genotype and
site-level imputation **R² ≥ 0.8**. This is the denominator for both agreement rates.

```{r overall}
knitr::kable(data.frame(
  Measure=c('Included isoLASER calls','Panel genotype available','Adjudicable calls',
            'Alternate allele confirmed','Exact genotype agreement'),
  Calls=fmt(c(nrow(x),sum(x$inPanel),nrow(hq),sum(confirmed),sum(exact))),
  Definition=c('PASS SNVs; DP ≥ 10',
    paste0(pct(sum(x$inPanel),nrow(x)),' of included calls'),
    'Panel genotype available; R² ≥ 0.8',
    paste0(pct(sum(confirmed),nrow(hq)),' of adjudicable calls'),
    paste0(pct(sum(exact),nrow(hq)),' of adjudicable calls'))),row.names=FALSE)
```

**Alternate-allele confirmation** requires matching reference and alternate
alleles and a non-reference panel genotype. **Exact genotype agreement** also
requires the same number of alternate alleles, ignoring phasing orientation.
For example, panel **0/1** and isoLASER **1/1** confirm the alternate allele but
are not an exact genotype match.

Among adjudicable calls, `r fmt(sum(hq$g_nalt==0))` have a homozygous-reference
panel genotype and `r fmt(sum(!hq$alleles_match))` have different alleles.
These categories can overlap; neither contributes to alternate-allele confirmation.

# Main discrepancy: heterozygotes called homozygous

Among allele-matched, adjudicable calls with a heterozygous panel genotype,
**`r fmt(sum(p$i_nalt==2))` / `r fmt(nrow(p))`
(`r pct(sum(p$i_nalt==2),nrow(p))`)** are called homozygous-alternate by isoLASER.

![Genotype discrepancy by variant-site read depth, across all autosomes and samples.](assets/isolaser_validation_all_autosomes/depth_discrepancy.png)

Here **DP is the number of reads overlapping the variant position in the
isoLASER gVCF**. It is different from the informative-read count for a particular
variant–exonic-part association used in the allele-specific splicing screen.
Thus, a variant-site DP cutoff and a splicing-association read cutoff address
different quantities.

The discrepant calls have a median reported alternate-read fraction (AB) of
**`r sprintf('%.2f',median(p[i_nalt==2]$AB,na.rm=TRUE))`**. A homozygous call
therefore does not necessarily mean that no reference-allele reads were observed.

## What changes with a higher depth cutoff?

These are **nested filters on the same completed variant calls**, not new
isoLASER runs. The last column uses only allele-matched, adjudicable panel
heterozygotes at the stated depth; it has a different denominator from the two
agreement columns.

```{r thresholds}
t <- fread(file.path(asset,'depth_thresholds.tsv'))
knitr::kable(data.frame(
  `Minimum variant DP`=t$Minimum_DP,
  `Calls retained`=fmt(t$Calls),
  `Adjudicable`=fmt(t$Adjudicable),
  `Allele confirmed (%)`=pct(t$Confirmed,t$Adjudicable),
  `Exact genotype (%)`=pct(t$Exact,t$Adjudicable),
  `Panel het → hom-alt (n/N; %)`=paste0(fmt(t$Called_hom_alt),'/',fmt(t$Panel_heterozygotes),
                                    ' (',pct(t$Called_hom_alt,t$Panel_heterozygotes),')'),
  check.names=FALSE),row.names=FALSE)
```

Increasing DP trades coverage for agreement in the retained subset. It cannot
recover heterozygotes missed by the original caller or restore their contribution
to phasing. These repeated donor/timepoint observations are descriptive counts,
not independent biological replicates.

# Results by chromosome and timepoint

Each row combines four donors. The table is displayed in full and can be searched
or sorted; [download the counts](assets/isolaser_validation_all_autosomes/chromosome_timepoint.tsv)
for further comparisons.

**Column guide:** **Calls** = retained isoLASER calls; **In panel** = calls with
an unambiguous callable donor panel genotype, regardless of R² or allele match;
**Adjudicable** = In panel with R² ≥ 0.8. **Allele confirmed (%)** and
**Exact genotype (%)** use Adjudicable as their denominator and the definitions
above. A site observed in two donors counts twice.

```{r per-chromosome}
s <- fread(file.path(asset,'chromosome_timepoint.tsv'))
table <- data.frame(Chromosome=s$chr,`Time (hours)`=sub('hr','',s$tp),
  Calls=s$Calls,`In panel`=s[['In panel']],Adjudicable=s$Adjudicable,
  `Allele confirmed (%)`=pct(s$Confirmed,s$Adjudicable),
  `Exact genotype (%)`=pct(s$Exact,s$Adjudicable),check.names=FALSE)
DT::datatable(table,rownames=FALSE,options=list(paging=FALSE,scrollX=TRUE,order=list(),dom='fti'))
```

# Calls absent from the panel

**`r fmt(sum(!x$panel_position))` calls** have no panel record at their position.
Another `r fmt(sum(x$panel_position & !x$inPanel))` have a panel record but no
unambiguous callable donor genotype. Neither group is validated by this comparison.

![Alternate-read fractions among isoLASER-labeled heterozygous calls, by timepoint and panel availability.](assets/isolaser_validation_all_autosomes/allele_balance.png)

The histograms include **only calls isoLASER labels heterozygous**, across all
22 autosomes; the vertical scales differ between panels. Their allele fractions
are conditional on this call label and do not independently establish accuracy
or mapping bias. RNA allele fractions may also reflect allele-specific expression.

# Interpretation and reproducibility

This comparison measures agreement **among variants isoLASER called**. It does
not estimate sensitivity, since panel variants missed by isoLASER are not counted,
and the imputed panel is not an error-free truth set. Alternate-allele confirmation
and exact genotype agreement should both be reported because phasing depends on
recognizing heterozygous sites.

The results were regenerated from all 264 gVCFs using
`8.isolaser_validation/19.validate_all_autosomes.py`; summaries and figures use
`8.isolaser_validation/20.all_autosome_assets.R`. The earlier chr1/chr10-only
assets are preserved separately.

Downloads: [call-level comparison (compressed TSV)](assets/isolaser_validation_all_autosomes/calls.tsv.gz),
[run manifest and exclusions](assets/isolaser_validation_all_autosomes/run_manifest.tsv),
[depth threshold counts](assets/isolaser_validation_all_autosomes/depth_thresholds.tsv).

Related pages: [genome-wide allele-specific splicing](isolaser_genome_wide.html),
[isoLASER per donor](isolaser_per_donor.html).
